profile.summary: William James College is a nonprofit college in Newton, Massachusetts. It trains professionals for careers in mental health, behavioral health and organizational leadership, with graduate and undergraduate programs in psychology, counseling and applied behavior analysis. Its approach combines classroom instruction with supervised field experience.
